Services

I build backend logic and REST APIs with C#, ASP.NET Core, PHP and Laravel. My work includes manufacturing ERP modules, asynchronous analysis workflows and recipe management APIs using EF Core and LINQ.

I build interfaces with React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Vue.js, HTML and CSS. In AlgoDojo, reusable SVG visualisations and shared playback controls make algorithms easier to explore.

I work with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL and relational data modelling. I connect business rules to database constraints, queries and persistent workflows across APIs and full-stack applications.

My toolkit includes Git, GitHub Actions, Docker, Postman, unit testing, debugging and object-oriented programming. I follow work through implementation, testing and deployment, with experience supporting a production PHP website. I also use Java, Python, Node.js / Express and Linux fundamentals.

About

I'm a backend-focused software engineer who connects data, business logic and the interfaces people use.

At TheRad, I built Laravel ERP modules, supported a production PHP website and independently delivered a platform of 26 maths games.

My projects explore asynchronous chess analysis, interactive algorithms and recipe APIs. I bring a practical approach: understand the problem, model the data and follow the work through testing and delivery.

FAQ

I'm interested in junior backend and full-stack software engineering opportunities. I enjoy connecting data models, business logic and useful interfaces, and I'm based in Johannesburg, South Africa.

My core stack is C# / .NET, PHP / Laravel, SQL and React / TypeScript. My projects also use Next.js, PostgreSQL, EF Core, Docker and Python / PyTorch. The Services section covers my wider toolkit.

At TheRad, I worked remotely as a Junior Software Engineer from September 2025 to April 2026. I developed Laravel / Filament ERP modules, worked with relational data, delivered a platform of 26 maths games and resolved defects on a client-facing Joomla / PHP website.

The Works page links to project repositories, the live AlgoDojo application and an OJGroceries walkthrough. ChessLens is in development with local Docker deployment; KitchenBuddy API and SnakeAI are available for source review.
